item.title: By: carl
item.dc:creator: carl
item.description:
It is very humbling isn't it? Especially as I becomes more aware of the sameness (mysterious or otherwise) between 'them' and me. Sure, I don't "panic and spend my life savings" like they do. Still, the difference between those <a href="https://centertao.local/tao-te-ching/dc-lau/#chapter-20" rel="nofollow">foolish and uncouth</a> souls and myself is vanishingly small. Knowing this makes me all the more <a href="https://centertao.local/tao-te-ching/dc-lau/#chapter-15" rel="nofollow">tentative and hesitant</a> as I wade through the river of life.
And Dan, it's nice to have you back here at the 'watering hole'. I was wondering how you were doing. :-)
item.content:encoded:
It is very humbling isn’t it? Especially as I becomes more aware of the sameness (mysterious or otherwise) between ‘them’ and me. Sure, I don’t “panic and spend my life savings” like they do. Still, the difference between those foolish and uncouth souls and myself is vanishingly small. Knowing this makes me all the more tentative and hesitant as I wade through the river of life.

And Dan, it’s nice to have you back here at the ‘watering hole’. I was wondering how you were doing. 🙂

item.title: By: Dan Littler
item.dc:creator: Dan Littler
item.description: How does this Rapture prophet keep getting followers? He said it was coming in 1994, load of people panicked and spent their life savings... Then again in May this year, and the same thing happened. Now, he's saying he's done the maths wrong again (just like when Homer Simpson predicted the Rapture), and that in fact it's October 21st 2011. Still, every time the Rapture fails to arrive, I'm tempted to put a pile of clothes on my garden to see if the neighbours are worried they've been left behind.
